item.incoming.strike_designator.hint.fir: LMB in binoculars — launch, wheel — weapon
incoming.weapon.drone.desc: Kamikaze drone: moped buzz, dive, blast
incoming.weapon.missile.desc: Cruise missile: terrain-hugging flight, pop-up, whistle, heavy blast
incoming.weapon.rocket.desc: Grad multiple rocket launcher: 40 tubes of unguided rockets fired in a ripple that covers an area
incoming.weapon.loiter.desc: Lancet loitering munition: circles over the target, pick what to hit in its camera (%s), dives
incoming.weapon.bunker.desc: B-2 with a bunker buster: the bomb penetrates the ground and explodes underground
incoming.target.locked: ⌖ Target: %s — the strike will follow it
incoming.target.unseen: %s has not been spotted: a player or aircraft can be struck only when you or your team see it, directly or through your projectile's camera
incoming.target.last_seen: ⌖ Target: where %s was seen %s s ago
incoming.target.locked.camera: ⌖ Target: %s — the strike follows it while you keep it in the camera frame (%s); otherwise it goes where it was last seen
incoming.target.locked.point: ⌖ Target: %s — the strike hits where it was seen; only the Shahed and the Lancet follow a moving target, through the camera
incoming.launch.no_site: No room for a launcher: buildings block the launch path. The strike comes in from afar.
incoming.launch.no_site.ordered: No room for a launcher at the launch point: rounds start from there without one.
incoming.launched.drone: Shahed leaving the launcher. Impact in ~%s s; watch it with the camera (%2$s).
incoming.launched.missile: Cruise missile launched. Impact in ~%s s.
incoming.launched.rocket: Grad: rocket away. Impact in ~%s s.
incoming.launched.loiter: Lancet launched from the catapult. Impact in ~%s s; pick the target in its camera (%2$s, LMB).
incoming.launched.bunker: B-2 airborne and heading for the bomb run. Release in ~%s s.
incoming.launch_failed: Launch failed: the world near the target is not loaded
incoming.too_many_active: Too many strikes in progress (%s, limit %s): wait for impacts or press Abort
incoming.munitions.short.rounds: Not enough rockets: %s — need %s, have %s (%s per pack)
incoming.munitions.refunded.dead: You died: the returned munitions were dropped where you fell
incoming.salvo.started.drone: ✈ Shahed salvo: %s drones, spread %s blocks. First one in ~5 s.
incoming.salvo.started.missile: ➶ Cruise missile salvo: %s missiles, spread %s blocks. First one in ~7 s.
incoming.salvo.started.bunker: ✹ B-2 raid: %s bombs, spread %s blocks. First run in ~3 s.
incoming.salvo.started.rocket: ☄ Grad salvo: %s rockets, spread %s blocks. One rocket every half second.
incoming.salvo.started.loiter: ✈ Lancet swarm: %s, spread %s blocks. They circle over the target and dive one by one.
incoming.cleared: All drones, missiles, bombs, salvos and nuclear strikes cancelled (total: %s). Destroyed blocks are not restored.
incoming.cleared.conventional: Drones, missiles, bombs and salvos cancelled (total: %s); nuclear strikes are not affected. Destroyed blocks are not restored.
incoming.recalled: Strikes aborted: %s projectiles stopped, %s salvos cancelled. A nuclear strike cannot be aborted; Grad rockets in flight and a dropped bomb still hit.
incoming.no_permission: The designator is for operators only (setting designator_for_everyone)
incoming.route.out_of_range: Route point too far: the limit is %s blocks from you
incoming.route.too_long: %s cannot fly this route: %s km, range %s km
incoming.route.outside_world: Point %s %s is outside the world border
incoming.hud.scope_hint: LMB — launch · wheel — weapon · Shift+RMB — console
incoming.remote.title: ☢ STRIKE CONSOLE
incoming.remote.clear.tooltip: Call off your strikes: projectiles self-destruct in the air, the B-2 turns away, salvos are cancelled and unfired munitions return to your inventory
incoming.remote.hint.look: Center: the point you are looking at
incoming.remote.hint.player.camera: The strike goes where the player was seen and follows them while you keep them in the camera frame (%s)
incoming.remote.hint.player.point: The strike goes where the player was seen
incoming.remote.hint.no_players: Nobody spotted: players appear here when you or your team see them
incoming.remote.hint.aircraft.camera: The strike goes where the aircraft was seen and follows it while you keep it in the camera frame (%s)
incoming.remote.hint.aircraft.point: The strike goes where the aircraft was seen
incoming.remote.hint.no_map: Pick a location on the map
incoming.remote.hint.map_route: Target: map location X %s, Z %s · route: %s points
incoming.help.title: ━━━━━━  ☢ INCOMING  ━━━━━━
incoming.help.1: Strike Designator: RMB — binoculars, LMB — launch, wheel — weapon, Shift+RMB — console
incoming.help.3: /incoming missile <player or mob> — at the target; a player must have been spotted (operators: no restrictions)
incoming.help.4: /incoming bunker at <x y z> — at a point; the bomb penetrates down to a target in a cave
incoming.help.5: /incoming salvo <weapon> <count> <spread> [me|look|<target>|at x z|at x y z] — salvo; at x z — a place on the ground, at x y z — exactly this point
incoming.help.6: /incoming menu — console, /incoming clear — abort your strikes (operators and the host: all strikes), /incoming give — designator
incoming.help.7: Settings: Mods → Incoming → Config (power, glass, fires, siren, shake)
incoming.help.8: Sound follows the Ambient slider; shake and flash are client settings
incoming.help.9: Create Aeronautics aircraft are targets too: aim the binoculars or pick one in the console

death.attack.incoming.strike.item: %1$s died in an airstrike called by %2$s using %3$s

incoming.configuration.title: Incoming settings
incoming.config.rocket_power.tooltip: Per rocket of the salvo. TNT = 4.
incoming.config.block_damage.tooltip: Off: blasts hurt players and mobs but leave blocks intact. Nuclear strikes have their own setting.
incoming.config.shatter_glass.tooltip: The blast wave breaks glass beyond the crater wherever outside air reaches it; glass underground or under water stays intact.
incoming.config.fire.tooltip: Off: conventional blasts and burning debris start no fires.
incoming.config.debris_stay.tooltip: Off: debris disappears when it lands.
incoming.config.collapse.tooltip: An underground blast brings down the roof of the cavity above it.
incoming.config.siren.tooltip: Players within 350 blocks of the target hear a siren and see a warning before a conventional strike. The nuclear alarm has its own radius.
incoming.config.max_salvo.tooltip: A larger salvo ordered by a player is cut to this size. The console slider stops at 30.
incoming.config.max_spread.tooltip: A larger spread ordered by a player is cut to this one. The console slider stops at 150.
incoming.config.max_active_per_player.to: 0 — unlimited. Counts projectiles in flight and salvo shots not yet fired; operators are not limited
incoming.config.aim_range.tooltip: How far the binoculars reach. Farther targets are struck from the targeting map.
incoming.config.map_range.tooltip: The server loads the target area, and generates it where nobody has been: the larger the range, the more new world generation
incoming.config.map_players.tooltip: Same dimension, within map range: teammates always, others where they were last seen. Off: the map does not draw them, the designator target list stays
incoming.config.sight_rules.tooltip: The designator strikes another player or aircraft only if you or your team see it (or saw it recently, then at the last known place); the map shows others the same way
incoming.config.sight_memory.tooltip: How many seconds a player and their team remember a spotted player or aircraft
incoming.config.camera_shake.tooltip: 0 — off. Aim is never disturbed: only the camera shakes
incoming.config.flash.tooltip: Brightness of the on-screen flash from explosions. 0: no flash.
incoming.config.hud.tooltip: Your projectiles in flight with phase and time to impact, top right, and marks over them in the world.
incoming.config.zoom.tooltip: Magnification when you hold RMB with the designator.
item.incoming.geiger_counter.tip: In hand: clicks and dose rate above the hotbar
item.incoming.shahed.tip: Designator munition: one Shahed per launch
item.incoming.lancet.tip: Designator munition: one Lancet per launch
item.incoming.cruise_missile.tip: Designator munition: one missile per launch; a nuclear strike also uses a Nuclear Warhead
item.incoming.grad_rockets.tip: Designator munition for the Grad: 40 rockets, each launch uses one
item.incoming.bunker_buster.tip: Designator munition: one bomb per B-2 run; a nuclear strike also uses a Nuclear Warhead
item.incoming.icbm.tip: Designator munition: an intercontinental missile with a nuclear warhead, one per launch
item.incoming.nuclear_warhead.tip: Fitted to a cruise missile or a B-2 bomb when the console is set to a nuclear warhead
incoming.weapon.nuke.desc: ICBM with a nuclear warhead: flash, fireball, mushroom cloud, blast wave, fallout
incoming.launched.nuke: ☢ ICBM launched. Detonation on a timer: see the countdown at the top of the screen.
incoming.nuke.disabled: Nuclear weapons are disabled in the server config
incoming.nuke.ops_only: Nuclear strikes are for operators only (setting nuclear.ops_only)
key.incoming.second_key: Second key (confirm a nuclear launch nearby)
incoming.config.nuke_second_key_distance: A nuclear strike by a non-operator (ops_only off) needs another player within this many blocks to press “Second key”. Alone online: no key needed.
incoming.config.nuke_second_key_window.t: No second key in time: no launch, munitions are returned.
incoming.nuke.key.wait: ☢ %s: second key needed: another player within %s blocks of you must press %s within %s s
incoming.nuke.key.prompt: ☢ %s asks for the second key: %s at %s, %s. Confirm with %s (%s s left)
incoming.nuke.key.none: No nuclear launch within %s blocks is waiting for a second key
incoming.nuke.key.expired: ☢ No second key for %s s — launch cancelled
incoming.nuke.key.cancelled: ☢ A nuclear launch waiting for its second key or the alarm was aborted
incoming.nuke.alarm.armed: ☢ Nuclear alarm raised at the target. Launch in %s s
incoming.nuke.alarm.carrier: ☢ NUCLEAR ALARM: %s — strike on area %s, %s, launch in %s s
incoming.nuke.launch_detected.carrier: ☢ Launch detected: %s with a nuclear warhead from area %s, %s
incoming.nuke.no_retarget: A nuclear projectile can't be retargeted: the alarm and the second key were for its original target
incoming.nuke.alert.eta: Impact in %s s: take cover, get underground
incoming.nuke.countdown: ☢ ICBM in flight · %2$s kt · detonation in %1$s s
incoming.nuke.delayed: ☢ Detonation delayed: the target area is still loading
incoming.remote.burst.tooltip: Air: widest destruction, almost no fallout. Ground: crater, trinitite and a fallout trail with black rain
incoming.radiation.report: %s: dose %s Gy, dose rate %s, contamination %s R/h
incoming.help.10: /incoming nuke [kt] [air|ground]: ICBM where you look; nuke at <x y z> …; nuke now …: detonate at once (operators only)
incoming.help.11: /incoming radiation [player]: dose; radiation clear [players]: remove exposure

incoming.config.nuke_enabled.tooltip: Off: the ICBM, nuclear warheads and /incoming nuke do not work.
incoming.config.nuke_ops_only.tooltip: Off: any player who may use the designator can launch a nuclear strike; a non-operator then needs a second key from another player nearby.
incoming.config.nuke_default_yield.toolt: Yield when the command gives no number. 15 kt is the Hiroshima bomb. On the console the yield is chosen with a button.
incoming.config.nuke_max_yield.tooltip: A higher yield is lowered to this one. The console offers 1 and 15 kt.
incoming.config.nuke_effects_scale.toolt: 1.0: true to life (1 block = 1 m). Lower for small worlds
incoming.config.nuke_wave_speed.tooltip: Speed of the blast wave far from the fireball, as a share of the speed of sound. 1.0: true to life. Lower gives the server more time for ruins
incoming.config.nuke_block_damage.toolti: Off: the blast wave hurts players and mobs but leaves blocks intact; there are no ruins or crater.
incoming.config.nuke_fires.tooltip: The light of the fireball sets fires in the open.
incoming.config.nuke_tree_fall: Trees fall away from ground zero
incoming.config.nuke_tree_fall.tooltip: Trunks fall whole, away from ground zero. Off: the blast wave breaks trees block by block like everything else.
incoming.config.nuke_crater.tooltip: A ground burst digs a crater with trinitite on its floor. Needs “Blast destroys buildings and trees”.
incoming.config.nuke_fallout.tooltip: After a ground burst, a radioactive trail settles downwind.
incoming.config.nuke_radiation.tooltip: Players take a radiation dose from the burst and from fallout, and fall sick with radiation sickness.
incoming.config.nuke_mob_radiation.toolt: Mobs other than the undead take a dose from the burst and from fallout and sicken in the same stages as players. Off: prompt radiation kills them at once (from 1000 rem) or takes half their health (from 400 rem), and fallout does not affect them.
incoming.config.nuke_black_rain.tooltip: Black rain falls in the fallout trail. It contaminates until washed off with water.
incoming.config.nuke_flight_time.tooltip: 20 ticks = 1 s. A real ICBM flies about 30 minutes. A non-operator's strike takes at least 1800 ticks (90 s of alarm).
incoming.config.nuke_time_budget.tooltip: Limit for nuclear destruction within the total per-tick budget (mod work per tick). More is faster but may stutter
incoming.config.nuke_prep_budget: Ruins pre-build budget per tick, ms
incoming.config.nuke_prep_budget.tooltip: Milliseconds of each tick spent on pre-building ruins while the ICBM flies, so blocks fall with the blast front
incoming.config.nuke_far_zone: Generate the zone for far ruins
incoming.config.nuke_far_zone.tooltip: With Distant Horizons: the heavy zone that is not on disk yet (edge of the explored world) is generated in the background behind the wave, so the ruins are visible from afar at once. Off: ruins appear there only when a player walks there
incoming.config.nuke_ruin_threads.toolti: Background threads that build ruin plans from chunk snapshots and read far chunks from disk; 0 uses all cores but three (server, rendering, world I/O), and the mod lowers or raises how many work by server tick time
incoming.config.nuke_max_fires.tooltip: Fires lit by the thermal pulse of one detonation, at most.
incoming.config.nuke_warning_radius.tool: Players this close to the target hear the nuclear alarm and see the countdown.
incoming.config.nuke_dust_quality: Mushroom cloud, dust wall and pall
incoming.config.nuke_dust_quality.toolti: The fireball and the mushroom cloud (with the water column of a burst on water), the dust wall of a nuclear blast wave and the dust and smoke that hang over the area after it (over water, spray and the base surge), drawn as a volume. LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH: rougher or finer; lower is lighter on a weak graphics card, and MEDIUM and HIGH lower their own detail when the card falls behind (not while Flashback exports a video). OFF: no dust wall, no pall and no base surge (and no muffled sounds in it), only the dust close around you and falling ash; the fireball, the mushroom cloud and the water column stay, at LOW.
incoming.config.nuke_tinnitus.tooltip: After a nearby blast wave, sounds go muffled and your ears ring for a while.
incoming.config.sound_muffling.tooltip: Strikes far away lose their high tones, and strikes behind a hill or wall sound muffled; with Sound Physics Remastered installed, that mod does this instead. Inside the nuclear dust pall, distant sounds are muffled too.
incoming.config.map_prefetch.tooltip: While a designator is in the inventory or the map was opened — the map opens instantly
incoming.nuke.detonating: ☢ %s kt detonation (%s) at %s %s %s as soon as the area loads
incoming.map.video_at: Video within %s m of you (now %s m)
incoming.map.title: Targeting map
incoming.map.hint: LMB — strike location or player · drag — pan · wheel — zoom · space — to me
incoming.map.selected_player_away: Target: %s — not in this dimension or not on the map yet · Enter — fire
incoming.map.near_only: Terrain from loaded chunks only; Distant Horizons shows far terrain
incoming.map.far_pending: Distant Horizons is still loading its own terrain; far terrain will appear when it answers
incoming.map.no_ceiling: No map strikes in a world with a ceiling (the Nether): the map sees only the roof
incoming.map.out_of_range: Too far: map strikes reach up to %s blocks
incoming.map.route.hint: Route: Shift+LMB — add point (up to %s) · drag a point — move · RMB — remove
incoming.map.route.no_target: Route: %s of %s points · pick a target (LMB)
incoming.map.route.too_long: Route %s is beyond the weapon range (%s): remove or move points
incoming.map.route.weapon: %s does not fly routes; the Shahed, Missile and Lancet do
incoming.map.route.unused: %s ignores the route and flies to the target on its own
incoming.map.launch.tooltip: Where the projectiles take off: a launcher is set up there. On the map, Ctrl+LMB also picks it; drag the mark to move it, RMB on it to remove it. Operators and the world host only.
incoming.map.launch.label: launch
incoming.map.launch.hint: Launch: from you · Ctrl+LMB — pick a launch site
incoming.map.launch.picking_hint: Launch: click where the projectiles take off · Esc — cancel
incoming.map.launch.set: %s · a launcher is set up there
incoming.map.launch.approach: %s · the %s comes in from this side
incoming.map.launch.unused: %s · the %s takes off from its own site and ignores it
incoming.map.launch.ops_only: Only an operator or the world host can pick a launch site
incoming.map.launch.out_of_range: Launch site too far: up to %s blocks from you
incoming.camera.hint: LMB — new target · %s — next · Shift — exit · F5 — view
incoming.camera.loiter: LOITERING · put the crosshair on a target and press LMB to strike
incoming.camera.pursuit.waiting: TARGET OUT OF FRAME · HEADING TO LAST SEEN POINT
incoming.remote.warhead.tooltip: Nuclear warhead on the cruise missile or the B-2 bomb: a single round, yield of your choice. The missile bursts over the target or at the ground, the bomb underground after drilling.
incoming.config.launch_near_player: Launch from a launcher near the player
incoming.config.launch_near_player.toolt: Shaheds and missiles take off from a mobile launcher behind the player. Off: they come in from afar.
incoming.config.drone_flight_time.toolti: Launch to impact: a detour route and the attack run. Never shorter than the direct path.
incoming.config.missile_flight_time.tool: Launch to impact, never shorter than the direct path.
incoming.config.bomber_flight_time.toolt: From the order to bomb release.
incoming.config.loiter_time.tooltip: How long a Lancet circles before diving (±20% per Lancet in a salvo). Pick a target from its camera to strike sooner.
incoming.config.carrier_nukes: Nuclear warhead on missile and B-2
incoming.config.carrier_nukes.tooltip: Allow a nuclear warhead on carriers other than the ICBM. Same permissions as the ICBM.
incoming.config.auto_camera.tooltip: Every launch of yours is shown automatically: the launch from the side, the flight from on board, the impact. Shift exits.
incoming.config.grid_enabled.tooltip: A strike on a substation cuts power to its area: electric lights go out district by district.
incoming.config.grid_node_radius.tooltip: Blocks powered by a placed substation.
incoming.config.grid_max_radius.tooltip: Blocks. Nothing further goes dark, even after a nuke.
incoming.config.grid_cascade_speed.toolt: Blocks per second the outage spreads across districts.
incoming.config.grid_restore_spread.tool: Seconds over which districts get power back, in random order.
incoming.config.grid_nuke: Nuke cuts power in its radius
incoming.config.grid_nuke.tooltip: A nuclear detonation cuts power within its whole damage radius, without a substation.
incoming.config.grid_time_budget.tooltip: Limit for blackout lights within the total per-tick budget (mod work per tick).
incoming.config.far_range: Far sight and hearing range, blocks
incoming.config.far_range.tooltip: Beyond render distance players see and hear projectiles in flight and conventional blasts up to this range (haze still hides them by the weather)
incoming.config.work_budget.tooltip: At most how many milliseconds of each server tick the mod spends on heavy work in total: strike destruction, then the nuke, then blackout lights. The full budget only comes from the time left in the tick; a server that is behind gets about 2 ms per kind of work, and 6 ms more for nuclear ruins a player can see.
incoming.help.12: /incoming grid status|blackout|restore|node …: power grid status, cut power to an area, restore power, map nodes
incoming.help.13: /incoming salvo … [from x z] [via x z …] — launch point (operators) and route points, as on the map; a single round — salvo <weapon> 1 0 …
incoming.help.14: /incoming launcher <x y z> [fire|clear|load N|owner …|mission <weapon> N spread x z|x y z [via …]] — fixed launcher (operators)
incoming.grid.status: Outages: %s, grid nodes: %s (chunks queued %s, lamps to relight %s)
incoming.grid.status_clock: Queue: %s units last tick (budget %s ms), next unit estimate %s ms, longest unit in 5–10 s %s ms
incoming.grid.status_head: Chunk taken most times in a row: %s %s, %s times
incoming.grid.status_reads: Chunk reads from disk not for the world (since start): on other threads %s, copies of loaded chunks %s
item.incoming.interceptor.tip: Load into a SAM: right-click the SAM with it, or use a hopper or a Create funnel
incoming.config.sam_radar_range.tooltip: Stealthy targets (B-2, cruise missile, Lancet) are detected at shorter range
incoming.config.sam_engage_range.tooltip: Shoots down hostile Shaheds, cruise missiles, Lancets and B-2s; not ICBMs or Grad rockets
incoming.config.sam_kill_probability.too: 0–1: share of bursts near the target that bring it down as debris
incoming.config.sam_rails.tooltip: Missiles ready to fire at once; the rest wait in stock.
incoming.config.sam_reload.tooltip: Seconds to put the next missile from stock on a free rail.
incoming.sam.alert_many: Air raid alert! Targets: %s, nearest — %s: %s, %s km
incoming.sam.status: SAM: %s of %s on the rails, %s in stock; hostile targets %s, on radar %s
incoming.sam.covered: SAM: blocked from above, cannot fire

incoming.fixed_launcher.status: Launcher: %s ×%s at %s %s, spread %s; rounds in stock: %s
incoming.fixed_launcher.linked: Launcher linked to the designator (%s total): Fire now gives the launchers a mission
incoming.fixed_launcher.unlinked: Launcher unlinked from the designator (%s left)
incoming.fixed_launcher.links_full: %s launchers are already linked to this designator
incoming.fixed_launcher.on_craft: the launcher does not fire from an aircraft
incoming.fixed_launcher.no_rights: the launcher's owner may not use the designator
incoming.fixed_launcher.out_of_range: target is more than %s blocks from the launcher
incoming.fixed_launcher.busy: the launcher is busy with the previous order
incoming.fixed_launcher.no_nuke: The launcher does not take a nuclear warhead
incoming.fixed_launcher.unsupported: The launcher cannot fire %s: only what starts from a rack (Shaheds, Lancets, cruise missiles, Grad)
incoming.fixed_launcher.elsewhere: the launcher is in another dimension
incoming.fixed_launcher.not_loaded: the launcher is far away, its area is not loaded
incoming.fixed_launcher.gone: the launcher is gone and was unlinked
incoming.fixed_launcher.none_here: There is no fixed launcher here
incoming.fixed_launcher.owner: Launcher owner: %s — rounds fly in their name, under their rules
incoming.fixed_launcher.owner.none: The launcher has no owner: it fires without player rules, like the server console
item.incoming.strike_designator.launcher: Linked launchers: %s — Fire gives them a mission
item.incoming.strike_designator.hint.lin: RMB on a fixed launcher — link it
